newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Bankruptcy, debt relief filings down in Sao Paulo.
newsitem.headline: Bankruptcy, debt relief filings down in Sao Paulo.

text.p: Filings for debt relief in Sao Paulo city dropped 71 percent in September against the same period last year, the Centralized Bank Services (Serasa) said in a statement.
Bankruptcy filings fell 10 percent in September to 3,131 against the same month last year. It also fell 24 percent when compared to August, Serasa said.

The drop in bankruptcy and debt relief filings is a result of an increase in sales, which were boosted by expansion of credit, lower interest rates and a drop in unemployment. -- Romina Nicaretta, Sao Paulo newsroom, 55-11-2324411.
